title: WDCS Functionalities
description:
At WDCS the warehouse management I created the Inventory Adjustments History page from front end to backend including paginations and column searching and sorting, Work history page from front end to backend including paginations and column searching and sorting.

I also added Inventory amount notifications (bulk or single item) the users could set up to be notified when reaching that amount.

Modified reports layout for better viewing.

Added users tab to the permission and the group integrants.

Added state change functionality for QA (Quality assurance) transfers.

Added new permissions and their validation on the relevant sites.

Created the upload and deletion page for velocity profiles.
